info.name: XMH API
info.description:
DRFT Backend API — Claims & Insurance Management System.

## Variables
- `base_url`: `http://localhost:5000/api/v1`
- `accessToken`: Set via Login/Refresh requests using Test script.

## Multipart Endpoints
For endpoints that accept file uploads (`POST /claims`, `POST /auth/complete-profile`, `PATCH /users/me`, `POST /upload`):
- Send all text fields inside a `data` key as a JSON string
- Send files under their respective field names

The server parses the `data` JSON and merges it with uploaded file URLs.
